notes.title: Update 1/10/2017
notes.notes:
We have corrected typos and punctuation errors. 

Now we are focused on our new game "The Agony" (Store page). We think it will appeal to everyone who enjoyed the "Sixtieth Kilometer." But we also have plans for “Sixtieth Kilometer”. We want to release a DLC with a short story. In it you will learn about what happened to the world after the pink fog disappeared. Of course, you will meet familiar characters. Some of them were not as deep and interesting as we wanted in the original version, and we're going to fix it. How do you like this idea? Write your opinion in the comments!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12132904/52d4342f2d0553648196de1784a56ac49ea0811b.png

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
We're fixed several mistakes in dialogues, story lines and translation.
The development of the novel "Sixtieth Kilometer" started in the end of 2014 and the story was written back in 2011-2012! The project faced many difficulties since then and we had to change artists and translators several times. We hope you like the result! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12132904/45ba0c049b71786fb855d518d6846ec6100437d7.jpg

Also we're developing a new visual novel that is a spiritual successor of the Sixtieth Kilometer. It's called "The Agony". We are working really hard to make this new project even better. You can support us and vote for the game in  Steam Greenlight!

notes.title: Full release
notes.notes:
We finally released the full version of our novel. It was a long road for us. The development of the novel "Sixtieth Kilometer" started in the end of 2014 and the story was written back in 2011-2012! The project faced many difficulties since then and we had to change artists and translators several times. We hope you like the result!

After the release of this novel we will start the development of a new intriguing story. We'll tell you more about this project soon. We are sure that you'll like it if you liked "Sixtieth Kilometer".

We'll release a few more updates for our game later to add more story branches. Stay tuned!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12132904/6d64a03e7e74c84f2d6e4d5301ca002578b5da1a.png
